This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Romania.
 We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to strengthen the quality and reliability of mobile application releases across iOS and Android platforms. In this hands-on role, you will take ownership of manual regression testing, exploratory testing, bug identification, and release validation. You will collaborate closely with developers, QA specialists, and release managers to ensure smooth, predictable release cycles. Your work will directly contribute to improving product stability, user experience, and overall software quality. This is an execution-focused opportunity for someone who enjoys investigating complex issues, anticipating potential risks, and maintaining high testing standards. You will join a globally distributed engineering environment that values proactive communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 Accountabilities
Execute comprehensive manual regression test cycles on iOS and Android release candidates across a range of supported devices and operating systems.
Identify, document, and report bugs with clear reproduction steps, environment details, relevant logs, and severity assessments.
Conduct exploratory testing on new features and user journeys to uncover edge cases and potential issues not detected by automated testing.
Triage incoming bugs from internal testing, production incidents, and user feedback channels, prioritizing issues according to their impact and severity.
Collaborate with developers and release managers throughout release candidate cycles to verify fixes, resolve blockers, and support release decisions.
Create, maintain, and expand manual testing documentation, including test cases, checklists, and regression matrices within test management platforms.
Perform release-day validation, including smoke testing on production builds and post-release monitoring to ensure product stability.
Contribute to improving QA processes, testing consistency, and communication across distributed teams.
 Requirements
3–5 years of hands-on manual QA experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android.
Strong attention to detail, proactivity, and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality products.
Proven experience writing structured and actionable bug reports, including reproduction rates, device and OS information, logs, and severity classifications.
Experience managing or supporting complete regression testing cycles within scheduled release environments.
Strong exploratory testing capabilities, including session-based, risk-prioritized, and well-documented testing approaches.
Familiarity with test management and bug-tracking tools such as TestRail, Xray, Zephyr, Jira, Shortcut, or Notion.
Experience conducting real-device testing through BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar platforms.
Excellent written English and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across international time zones.
Availability to overlap with Central European Time (CET) business hours for at least four hours per day.
Eligibility to work in the country of residence.
Nice to have: Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, WebdriverIO, or Appium.
Nice to have: Basic proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, or Go.
Nice to have: Previous experience testing cryptocurrency wallets, DeFi platforms, fintech applications, or products handling sensitive financial and user data.
Nice to have: Exposure to containerized or cloud-based testing infrastructure and browser extension testing across Chrome, Firefox, or Brave.
Nice to have: Familiarity with log and network inspection tools such as Charles Proxy, Xcode Instruments, and Android Studio Logcat.
Nice to have: Understanding of release management workflows and release candidate gating processes.
 Benefits
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Fully remote working environment with flexible working hours.
Opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals from diverse international backgrounds.
Excellent learning, professional development, and career growth opportunities.
Exposure to fast-paced, challenging, and innovative projects within the blockchain and Web3 ecosystem.
Opportunity to contribute to products shaping the future of decentralized finance and digital asset management.
International and collaborative working environment with a relatively flat organizational structure.
Flexibility to work remotely from an eligible country, with the ability to collaborate across global teams.
